verdict.rationale: Trello's own docs claim built-in automation of tasks and workflows, so the capability belongs to the product itself. The pack gives only that single marketing line, though. Nothing describes triggers, schedules, or rules that run unattended in the background. Card buttons are user-triggered actions, and webhooks and the API are developer building blocks, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: documented trigger- or schedule-based rules that run autonomously, details on background execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
